title: LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Ungrade Neutral Color Recovery
summary: A specialized In-Context LoRA for the LTX-2.3 video foundation model designed to remove cinematic color grading and contrast. It processes input videos to restore natural lighting and a neutral color balance, serving as a 'de-grading' tool for further production.
research_notes: Created by Oumoumad Mohamed; part of a suite of utility IC-LoRAs that include outpainting and HDR conversion.

evolution.summary: The LTX-2.3 (22B) series was the open-source peak of the family before the transition to LTX-3. While LTX-2.3 remains the standard for local ComfyUI workflows, the ecosystem has moved towards LTX-3 for professional long-form video generation.
